evidence: Hang Đao Street, also known as 行桃, is a historic street located within the ancient quarter of Hanoi. Stretching approximately 260 meters from north to south, it begins at the Đông Kinh Nghĩa Thục square near Hoàn Kiếm Lake and ends at the intersection with Hang Ngang Street.

The name Hang Đao Street originates from its historical role as a marketplace for red-dyed fabrics. Today, the street operates as a one-way thoroughfare for vehicles and remains a significant commercial area characteristic of Hanoi.
